title: Target evaluation of a quasicategorical lax comma construction
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functor simplicial sets, spaces, composition and degreewise simplicial pullbacks of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and inner and cocartesian fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. All objects fit in one fixed universe. Let $f:A\to B$ be an inner fibration of quasicategories that lifts equivalence edges with specified source. Form
$$T=A\times_{f,B,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,B),\qquad q=\operatorname{ev}_1:T\to B.$$
Then $T$ is a quasicategory and $q$ is a cocartesian fibration. Its objects are $(a,u:f(a)\to b)$. For $x=(a,u:f(a)\to b)$ and $y=(a',v:f(a')\to b')$ there is a natural equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_T(x,y)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_A(a,a')\mathop{\times}^{h}_{\operatorname{Map}_B(f(a),b')}\operatorname{Map}_B(b,b').$$
The two maps to the middle space are $h\mapsto v f(h)$ and $k\mapsto k u$, respectively. The homotopy pullback retains the path between these composites. Under this equivalence $q$ is projection to $k$, and precomposition and postcomposition agree with pasting coherent squares. Here $X\times_Z^hY$ denotes the path-space pullback of spaces, with its paths and all higher simplices. These assertions remain valid when $A$ is empty; no limits, colimits or presentability of $A$ or $B$ are assumed.
